networkDiscovery.notes: chrome-devtools MCP opened https://www.rolex.com/de-at/watches/find-rolex?group=0, confirmed the region switcher showed 'Österreich - Sprache umstellen', and clicked the 'Mehr ansehen' load-more control. Network inspection captured GET https://www.rolex.com/api/catalog/watchgrid?...countryCode=AT..., confirming the same public watchgrid endpoint used for the DE/US markets but scoped to countryCode=AT. Direct curl access to both the API and rendered HTML pages returned Akamai 403 'Access Denied' (bot protection); all structured and rendered fetches were therefore executed as fetch() calls from inside the live browser tab's JavaScript context via the MCP's evaluate_script, which succeeded (200 OK) because they carried the real browser session/TLS fingerprint.

primaryCollectionPath.pagination: A single request with firstResult=0 and numberOfResults=2000 (exceeding the market's total) returned totalCount=1465 and results.length=1465 in one response, i.e. results.length === totalCount with no further page available. This was independently confirmed by an initial numberOfResults=432 request (triggered by clicking 'Mehr ansehen' once) which reported the same totalCount=1465, showing totalCount is a fixed server-side total independent of the requested page size.

renderedCrossCheck.view: Modellansicht; group=0; no restrictive collection, size, material, or new-model filters
renderedCrossCheck.renderedCountsAfterEachLoad: Not fully enumerated by click-through; instead, the structured endpoint's terminal totalCount/results.length equality was used as the primary stop signal, and 19 individual product pages (17 collection representatives plus both members of two same-base-model pairs) were independently fetched from the live browser session and reconciled against the structured dataset (see independentSpotChecks in validation-summary.json).

catalogReconciliation.notes: Every AT modelReference already existed in the catalog from prior DE/US/JP collection runs; the catalog's watches array is unchanged. Only sourceMarketCodes gained 'AT'.

errors: Direct curl requests (no browser session) to both /api/catalog/watchgrid and rendered product pages under www.rolex.com returned HTTP 403 from Akamai ('Access Denied'); this is a bot-protection response, not evidence the endpoint or pages do not exist. All collection and spot-check requests were instead issued as same-origin fetch() calls from within the chrome-devtools MCP browser session, which succeeded.

The Coveo analytics endpoint (rolexsaproductionh21l80g7.analytics.org.coveo.com) failed DNS resolution in the sandboxed browser environment; this is an unrelated analytics beacon, not a catalog data source, and did not affect collection.
